sections.title: The Intuitive Hook: The Smoothie Analogy (0:00-0:45)
animations: Animation showing fruit separating into distinct color-coded zones.
Highlight individual ingredient labels (color #FFFFFF) for each zone.

sections.title: Prerequisite Visualization: Adding Sine Waves (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: Signals are sums of simple sine waves.
Even jagged waves have simple roots.
animations: Fade in three sine waves with distinct colors (#3498DB, #2ECC71, #E74C3C).
Animate waves overlapping to form a complex, jagged waveform.
Fade out complex wave, leaving individual waves flashing (#F1C40F).

sections.title: The Core Concept: Domain Shifting (1:45-3:00)
animations: Morph time signal into a frequency spectrum bar chart (#3498DB).
Sweep a vertical line (#E74C3C) across the frequency chart.
Flash high peaks on the bar chart to emphasize intensity.
Draw an arc connecting the two domains on screen.

sections.title: Practical Application: Noise Reduction (3:00-4:15)
animations: Display a noisy waveform (color #FFFFFF) with static fuzz.
Transform to frequency domain revealing distinct static spikes (#E74C3C).
Delete the static frequency spikes from the graph.
Transform back to time domain with smooth, clean waveform.
Fade in a checkmark graphic (#2ECC71) signifying success.

sections.title: Summary & Takeaway (4:15-5:00)
animations: Display the text 'Signal Deconstruction' (#FFFFFF) center screen.
Pulse all key terms on screen to signify summary importance.
